proof_body:
by
  intro a b c hab
  have hd : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm
  have hdn : 0 < ‖b - a‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hd
  set u := (c - a) / (b - a) with hu
  have hc : c = a + u * (b - a) := by rw [hu]; field_simp; ring
  have n1 : ‖a - b‖ = ‖b - a‖ := norm_sub_rev a b
  have n2 : ‖b - c‖ = ‖b - a‖ * ‖1 - u‖ := by
    rw [← norm_mul, hc]; congr 1; ring
  have n3 : ‖c - a‖ = ‖b - a‖ * ‖u‖ := by
    rw [← norm_mul, hc]; congr 1; ring
  have halg : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = a * b + b * c + c * a ↔ u ^ 2 - u + 1 = 0 := by
    have hexp : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - (a * b + b * c + c * a) = (b - a) ^ 2 * (u ^ 2 - u + 1) := by
      rw [hc]; ring
    constructor
    · intro h
      have : (b - a) ^ 2 * (u ^ 2 - u + 1) = 0 := by rw [← hexp, h]; ring
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 2 hd)
    · intro h
      have : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - (a * b + b * c + c * a) = 0 := by rw [hexp, h, mul_zero]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  rw [halg, n1, n2, n3]
  have hn : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = w.re ^ 2 + w.im ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
  have hone : ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ = 1 ↔ w.re ^ 2 + w.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro w
    rw [← hn, pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg w) two_ne_zero]
  have hcancel : (‖b - a‖ = ‖b - a‖ * ‖1 - u‖ ∧ ‖b - a‖ * ‖1 - u‖ = ‖b - a‖ * ‖u‖) ↔ (‖1 - u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖u‖ = 1) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have h3 : ‖1 - u‖ = 1 := by
        have := mul_left_cancel₀ hdn.ne' (show ‖b - a‖ * ‖1 - u‖ = ‖b - a‖ * 1 by linarith)
        exact this
      have h4 := mul_left_cancel₀ hdn.ne' h2
      exact ⟨h3, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      rw [h1, h2]; simp
  rw [hcancel, hone, hone]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hx : u.re = 1 / 2 := by nlinarith
    have hy : u.im ^ 2 = 3 / 4 := by rw [hx] at h2; linarith
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [pow_two, hx]
      nlinarith
    · simp [pow_two, hx]
      ring
  · intro h
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp [pow_two] at hre him
    have hy0 : u.im ≠ 0 := by
      intro hy
      rw [hy] at hre
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u.re - 1 / 2)]
    have hx : u.re = 1 / 2 := by
      have : u.im * (2 * u.re - 1) = 0 := by linarith
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hy0
      linarith
    rw [hx] at hre
    have hy : u.im ^ 2 = 3 / 4 := by nlinarith
    rw [hx]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
